listen.title: Earnings Night and a Rate Hold
listen.text: On earnings night, Alphabet reported third-quarter revenue of 127.58 billion dollars, about 0.3 billion below expectations, and GAAP EPS of 2.12, well below forecasts. Google Cloud rose to 30.7 billion dollars, up 103 percent year over year, but free cash flow turned negative, and shares fell more than 8 percent after-hours. Microsoft reported about 92.3 billion dollars in revenue, up 19 percent; Cloud topped 63 billion dollars and accelerated to about 30 percent, and the stock rose about 5 percent after-hours. The Federal Reserve held rates at 3.75 to 4.00 percent in a 10-to-2 vote; Cook and Hammack favored a 25-basis-point hike, so markets called the tone hawkish. Separately, total assets before the Hong Kong open are 9,385,983 Hong Kong dollars. A risk memo flags Zhipu at 7.9 percent versus a 5 percent position limit, Kingsoft Cloud combined at 9.9 percent versus the same cap, and cash at 8.8 percent, 1.2 points below the 10 percent cash buffer — a paraphrase of the memo, not advice.

questions.q: Dictation: Alphabet Q3 revenue was ______ billion dollars, about ___ billion below expectations; after-hours the stock fell more than ___ percent.

Dictation: The Fed held rates at ______ to ______ percent in a ___-to-___ vote.
Comprehension: What turned negative at Alphabet, and how did Microsoft shares move after-hours?
questions.a: Free cash flow (FCF) turned negative; Microsoft rose about 5% after-hours.

questions.q: Comprehension: Name the two position-limit figures and the cash figure from the paraphrase.
questions.a: Zhipu 7.9% vs 5%; Kingsoft Cloud combined 9.9% vs 5%; cash 8.8%, 1.2 points below the 10% buffer.

zh: 财报之夜，Alphabet 三季度营收 1275.8 亿美元，低于预期约 3 亿美元；GAAP 每股收益 2.12 美元，远低于预期。
谷歌云增至 307 亿美元，同比增 103%，但自由现金流转负，盘后股价跌超 8%。
微软营收约 923 亿美元，增 19%；云业务超 630 亿美元并加速至约 30%，盘后股价涨约 5%。
美联储以 10 比 2 维持利率在 3.75%–4.00%；Cook 和 Hammack 支持加息 25 个基点，市场认为基调偏鹰。
另外，港股开盘前总资产为 9,385,983 港元。
风险备忘标出智谱 7.9%（上限 5%）、金山云合计 9.9%（同上限）、现金 8.8% 比 10% 缓冲低 1.2 个点——这是对备忘的转述，不是建议。

speak.prompt: You are my English earnings-desk coach. Facts first, then labels. Alphabet Q3: revenue $127.58B (~$0.3B miss), GAAP EPS $2.12 below forecasts; Google Cloud $30.7B (+103% YoY); free cash flow turned negative; after-hours ~8%+. Microsoft ~$92.3B (+19%), Cloud >$63B accelerating to ~30%, after-hours +~5%. Fed rate hold 3.75%–4.00% (10–2); Cook and Hammack voted for a 25bp hike — hawkish. Oracle +~12%. Agoda books hotels via Meta's Muse booking agent. OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google TPUs (unconfirmed). Snapshot (total HKD 9,385,983): Zhipu 7.9% vs 5% position limit (+2.9pp); Kingsoft Cloud combined 9.9% vs 5% (+4.9pp); cash 8.8%, 1.2pp below the 10% cash buffer. Memo wording only: Kingsoft Cloud ≤5%; Zhipu at least to 5%; Alibaba plan ~4%; GOOGL do-not-buy; BKNG wait for 11/3. Prefer On the desk... / The memo says.... Never endorse trades. Language practice only, not investment advice.
questions: Open in 25 seconds: Alphabet's revenue miss, Cloud growth, and why free cash flow mattered after-hours.
Contrast Microsoft (~$92.3B, Cloud accelerating) with Alphabet in 30 seconds. Use after-hours for both moves.
Explain 'rate hold' and 'hawkish' with the 10–2 vote and the two dissenters.
Guest: 'What about the portfolio?' Paraphrase position limits and cash buffer only. End: 'I am paraphrasing the memo, not giving advice.'
Close in 20 seconds: Agoda via Muse as a booking agent; mark OpenAI's TPU plan as 'reportedly'.
speak.tip: 财报台：On the desk... / free cash flow / after-hours / rate hold / hawkish / reportedly。转述用 The memo says...，不背书。
speak.zh: 角色扮演：用英文点评 Alphabet、微软财报和美联储决议，并转述风险备忘。

read.title: After-Hours Splits, a Hawkish Hold, and Booking Agents
read.text: Thursday's X brief was an earnings-and-Fed night. Alphabet's third-quarter revenue of 127.58 billion dollars missed expectations by about 0.3 billion dollars; GAAP EPS was 2.12, well below forecasts. Google Cloud hit 30.7 billion dollars, up 103 percent year over year, but free cash flow turned negative, and the stock fell more than 8 percent after-hours. Microsoft printed about 92.3 billion dollars in revenue, up 19 percent, with Cloud above 63 billion dollars and growth accelerating to about 30 percent; shares rose about 5 percent after-hours. Oracle gained about 12 percent. The Federal Reserve held rates at 3.75 to 4.00 percent in a 10-to-2 decision; Cook and Hammack preferred a hike, so the tone was called hawkish. OpenAI reportedly plans to buy Google TPUs; neither side formally confirmed. Skift said Agoda has booked hotels through Meta's Muse booking agent. On sentiment, Tencent scored 8.1, PDD 8.2, Meituan 6.9 on a small sample, Alibaba 9.0 as Qwen4 'next week' dominated, Xiaomi 10.0, and Zhipu 8.0; Kingsoft Cloud had almost no sample. A same-day snapshot listed total assets of 9,385,983 Hong Kong dollars, with Zhipu above its 5 percent position limit and cash below the 10 percent cash buffer; memo wording here is for paraphrase practice only, not advice.

Cash was below the cash buffer.

write.task:
Write a 120–150 word English earnings-desk note.
